newsitem.title: USA: Fort Bliss officer resigns amid sex charges.
newsitem.headline: Fort Bliss officer resigns amid sex charges.

text.p: A senior Army officer at Fort Bliss has resigned amid allegations of sexual misconduct, Army officials said on Friday.
Col. Robert Jordan, the senior officer at the U.S. Army Sergeants Major Academy voluntarily stepped down, they said.
The academy trains enlisted Army leaders and is the only academy of its type in the country.
"This is not an admission of wrongdoing," said Fort Bliss spokesman Tom Collins. "He just felt it would be appropriate to step down."
The resignation follows still unproven allegations of misconduct against Jordan by a female employee and is the latest in a series of sexual harassment scandals at Fort Bliss.
Recently, an Equal Employment Opportunity Commission administrative judge ruled that Fort Bliss Col. Allen Hasbrouch had sexually harassed a female employee and ordered the base to pay her $300,000.

Last year, 20 women who worked at Fort Bliss accused the base of not taking appropriate action on sexual harassment cases and filed a lawsuit in federal court that is scheduled for trial here in August.
